label: For "Quality Improvement Initiative Prioritization": Rank proposed improvement projects by patient impact, compliance urgency, feasibility, cost, equity and expected benefit, giving leaders a transparent portfolio with trade-offs and assumptions to decide from. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Treating estimated benefits as certain.
